sources.title: Immigration and Passport Visa Exemption Order, 2026 (S.I. No. 26 of 2026)
sources.publisher: Attorney General's Chambers, Government of the Virgin Islands
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official laws host returns the gazetted instrument over HTTPS; its May 2026 asset is a narrow child/resident exemption rather than a foreign-national visitor schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: children under the age of 11 years born in the Territory to parents who are ordinarily resident

sources.title: Cabinet Office notice: Immigration and Passport Visa Exemption Order, 2026
sources.publisher: Cabinet Office, Government of the Virgin Islands
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Government notice, released 13 May 2026, identifies S.I. No. 26 of 2026 and its Official Gazette publication, but supplies no foreign ordinary-passport nationality list.
sources.supportingExcerpt: published for public review ... Gazette No. 48 dated 11th May, 2026
